what.text: This page follows people displaced inside the United States, as counted by IDMC, mostly by disasters.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 43987 people still displaced by disasters inside the country; IDMC reports this figure only for some years.
IDMC also recorded 732462 new displacements from disasters during 2025, a yearly count of movements, not people.

why.text: Floods, mass movements, storms and wildfires are among the disasters recorded for the United States in IDMC's data.
The fact pack records no conflict-related displacement inside the country.

when.text: IDMC's year-end figure for disaster displacement rose from 12896 in 2019 to 104611 in 2020, the main year of displacement in the data.
It was lower in the following years.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living.
IDMC's new displacements count each forced move during a year, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice; they are a separate count from the year-end figure.
